distribution.reason: Local-only candidates, no publication authorized. Rolling evidence does not qualify release v0.5.0.0: release cold-build, dependency closure, runtime lanes and schema-safe readiness remain pending. Whole-image licensing, source delivery admission and digest-bound source companion are incomplete for both channels.

constraints: Linux amd64 container runtime only. Rolling source-build observations were 24 bundled GHC closure libraries and GLIBC_2.38. Release v0.5.0.0 retains these strict build gates, but its actual closure and glibc floor are unmeasured; the upstream prebuilt artifact is not a substitute. The module-local OpenSSL legacy provider and pinned vendored libffi are required recipe inputs. Single token on slot 0; token-present index and native slot ID coincide at 0.

The adapter always provisions HASKOKI_CONFIG at /var/lib/p11lab/haskoki/haskoki.toml (PIN-free, deterministic): profile real-crypto, sqlite storage at /var/lib/p11lab/haskoki/token.sqlite, engine openssl over OpenSSL 4.0.2 (libcrypto statically linked into the module, so no system libcrypto is used or required, plus the legacy provider module shipped at ossl-modules/legacy.so beside the module, which upstream loads at open), trace disabled. The stored config bytes are verified on every invocation; drift fails as incompatible.

P11Lab initialization policy: label haskoki-demo, user PIN 1234 and SO PIN 5678 only; other initial values are refused. Release v0.5.0.0 supports durable native InitToken/InitPIN/SetPIN. Re-init on complete state is validate-only and must not restore changed PINs. Arbitrary initial PIN/label provisioning is not provided by this adapter.

Initialize only an empty writable /var/lib/p11lab volume; compatible init is non-destructive; partial or artifact-incompatible state fails. SQLite ownership is single-writer. Health uses stock haskoki-ctl config check and SELECT-only store inspect, never opens the writer module. Release schema3 runtime acceptance is pending: upstream store inspect counts tables but does not validate schema_version; schema-safe concurrent readiness needs explicit review, not silent migration/reset.
PIN_FILE/SO_PIN_FILE are preferred; scalar alternatives are explicit disposable-test inputs. Conflicting scalar/file or absent/empty credentials fail initial provisioning.
Ordinary application consumers do not require checker, Python, tracing or a workspace mount. Reset is an explicit removal/replacement of disposable state; no automatic reset or retry.
Whole-image licensing, source companion delivery and digest-bound admission remain separate requirements.
